news.title: With Netflix new ad-free standard plan at $20, streaming's tipping point into old TV is getting closer
news.description: The economics of streaming are nearing the point where cheaper plans with ads make as much if not more money for services like Netflix.

news.title: Meet the YouTube whisperers, a booming class of advisors behind MrBeast and other million-dollar channels
news.description: A burgeoning group of YouTube strategists are charging big money to YouTubers who want to expand their popularity.

news.title: Target is trying to win back busy families from Walmart, starting with the baby aisle
news.description: Target is refreshing its baby category as part of a broader effort to offer better products and more convenience to compete with Walmart and Amazon.
